strings: m_c has always been paranoid of other cats, believing that everyone is out to get {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.

m_c keeps accusing r_c of preying on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} downfall, despite the fact that r_c has done no such thing. m_c may have paranoid personality disorder.
